newsitem.title: ITALY: Final bids for Italy's Seat by July 21-Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Final bids for Italy's Seat by July 21-Treasury.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Thursday it had invited three companies bidding for yellow pages publisher Seat to present their final offers by July 21.

The Treasury said in a statement it would grant the chosen bid a period of exclusivity until the second week of August in which to finalise details of its offer, including possible participation of Telecom Italia in Seat's capital.

Three bidders are interested in Seat, which is up for sale after being spun off from state telecommunications holding Stet. Stet is itself due to be merged with Telecom Italia, its main operating unit, and privatised before the year end.
The three groups are GTE Directories, which is part of GTE Corp of the U.S., ITT World Directories and a group led by Banca Commerciale Italiana.
If the chosen group does not complete its bid preparations or withdraws its offer before the August deadline, negotiations will proceed with the second-ranked bid, the Treasury said.
